status: 20 individual procedure proposals and4 explicit source-decision holds; all24 unadopted/unpromoted.

commonProposals.status: All new procedures below are LOCAL PROPOSALS for actual GPT review. No source item, global rule or recipe is promoted.
commonProposals.authority: Original item text, price, tier, description, legal label and dependence DC remain copied verbatim. Printed facts and new completions are distinct. The four held items have no usable full profile in this draft.
commonProposals.administration: Use shared CU-01-01–14 as proposed, not adopted law. Unless a profile says otherwise, a brew is one pint/1 lb liquid in an actual separately counted container, consumed over one uninterrupted active minute. A substance uses one ready oral dose, one Action, actual hand/access and an eligible recipient able to swallow. No forced dosing of an unwilling active creature is granted. Completion is T0; all stated minute/hour clocks are exact elapsed clocks from the named event, preserved across initiative and sessions.
commonProposals.packaging: NEW substance packaging: a liquid/sap/resin/suspension dose has 0.1 lb gross mass: 0.08 lb content and a retained 0.02 lb vial, ampoule or pot. Quickglass uses that prepared draught. Null Salt and Choir Dust use 0.02 lb paper packets, comprising 0.01 lb content and 0.01 lb retained wrapper. Spiral Ink is one consumed 0.02 lb marked wafer. Wyrmspice is one 0.02 lb packet with the same 0.01/0.01 split. Prices purchase the source unit, not free bulk ingredients. No unit has an inferred crafting recipe. Carry all remaining actual containers and contents once.
commonProposals.doubling: NEW preparation: with two actual substance units, an actual suitable empty vessel, one free hand and one Action, combine their complete contents into one ready doubled portion; original containers remain. This preparation is not consumption. The combined ready portion may then be administered with one Action. It counts as two doses in one event under the shared proposal and grants only normal potency/duration. No preparation resurrects spilled/partial material. Different named substances cannot be combined into an invented compound profile.
commonProposals.magic: NEW classification proposal: special effects of these brews/substances, their item-specific damage and listed adverse effects are magical nonspell item effects unless expressly described as ordinary hydration or physical bookkeeping. They do not have spell ranks, casting components, RP costs or class-cast triggers. Dependence/tolerance/consumption records follow the existing recovery system and are not erased by spell-only dispelling. An actual suppressor/cure must match its printed scope. Suppression never pauses clocks or produces a delayed duplicate damage event; an ongoing timed adverse record can operate again only during its original remaining duration when suppression ends.
commonProposals.repetition: Same-item numerical bonuses/penalties use the strongest rather than adding; advantage/resistance do not stack. Each actual dose retains its own benefit end and crash. Different actual damage, Intoxication, Unity or Strain gain events remain distinct. Shared one-use entitlement policy is proposed CU-01-10. Each substance overdose also applies the shared proposed dependence advancement; its item-specific severe complication below is additional to the ordinary later crash.
commonProposals.life: Apply ordinary immunity, life state, damage/Wound/death and condition-source rules. A dose is no resurrection or extra body. No effect compels a player’s beliefs, behavior or real disclosure. Physical consumption is never refunded by later death, transformation or redundant benefits. If a recipient is Dead at a due event, apply only effects that can actually affect that target; no living-target save, corpse farming or postponed damage packet is invented. Existing timed records retain original timestamps through any genuine restoration unless that restoration explicitly ends them.
commonProposals.rest: The shared proposed beneficial-Long-Rest boundary remains an unresolved joint choice. It controls the individual references to a qualifying Long Rest below. No currently approved rest or maintenance chapter is overwritten.
commonProposals.damageReduction: NEW item-integration choice: Embermark’s 1 and Null Salt’s PB belong to one eligible pre-resistance flat-prevention group with the existing strongest class flat reduction; choose its highest applicable value, not their sum. Resolve save half, then this flat group, then actual resistance/immunity and later finite prevention. Post-defense transferred damage skips a second defense/reduction stage. This explicitly extends a scoped class rule to these items and needs independent review.

bardChantEvidence.scope: Exact current tags and whole cards, not a new tag inferred from name.

lineEvidence.exactText: Pure prevention removes damage without creating a second recipient. Elemental Absorption adds its resistance during ordinary defenses. Aura of Bonds and Crown reductions use the strongest applicable class flat reduction, then resistance/immunity. Finite/reactive prevention such as Bloom and Ancestral Guardian follows those defenses before post-defense transfer and temporary HP. Verify additional item/spell sources before treating this as universal defense ordering.

Attacks against unseen targets have disadvantage; unseen attackers have advantage, subject to the **Core Invisible exception**: once its position is known, Invisible's own attack modifiers end for that observer and cannot immediately return solely because it remains Invisible. Independent darkness, smoke, blindness or hiding can still supply modifiers.

Each Wound imposes **-1 Constitution saves** and reduces the normal maximum number of Hit Dice recovered per long rest by one, to a minimum of zero. It does not reduce each healing die. The broader recovery rules own the normal recovery maximum and rest legality.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

The cone begins at the edge of your space, extends 15 feet and has diameter equal to distance from the origin, reaching 15 feet across at its far end; your origin is excluded. On a grid, include a creature if the center of at least one occupied square lies within the cone footprint, including its boundary; resolve it only once. Use actual height and the same cone volume for airborne creatures. Total cover from the origin excludes a creature. A creature's location can be known without being visible, but the spell never finds an unknown location or identifies hidden allegiance.

**Supply is a basket of real goods:** 2 lb of ration-equivalent edible food, 8 pints of potable water, 1 pint of compatible lamp oil in its flask, and 0.25 lb of ordinary camp sundries. The food and water cover one Small or Medium character's daily demand; Large characters require twice those quantities. This is game accounting. Two pounds of food equal three reviewed Cooking servings; a Large food day is six servings.

At each canonical 24-hour day endpoint, settle each recipient's actual food, water and necessary declared logistics support. A recipient short of any requirement gains **1 expedition Strain total for that day's shortfall**. Missing food and water does not give two Strain. Retain partial consumption credit. The unsupported day blocks Strain removal; that block can clear on a later day only with a real sufficient provisioning plan available and maintained. Crossing a gate does not erase needs: actual Haven/home support pays needs outside the expedition.

- **Tags govern interactions:** verse, chant, echo, healing, sustained and so on are printed on cards. Names do not create tags. A Symphony is not automatically a Chant. Death-triggered Crescendo of Hope has its own explicit exception to normal activation requirements.
